newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly steady to higher.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly steady to higher on Monday as some banks decided to get more pesos ahead of a possible tightness in peso liquidity, traders said.
The two-week, one-month and twelve-month rates experienced slight increases.
"Some banks are just adjusting their rates. They've got a clearer trend of interest rates," said a foreign bank dealer.
After the Central Bank's dollar sales last Friday, some banks could be short of pesos, prompting banks to lift some of the swap rates in the PHIBOR market, dealers said.
